source: The preset applies when {0} has the dependency {1} or {2}. x18n reads {3}, {4}, {5}, {6} and the target dependency tables. For a renamed dependency, such as {7}, x18n sees the alias {8} and does not detect the preset, so list it.
text: 當 {0} 含有 {1} 或 {2} 相依套件時，會套用此預設集。x18n 會讀取 {3}、{4}、{5}、{6} 以及目標相依套件表。對於重新命名的相依套件（例如 {7}），x18n 只會看到別名 {8}，因此不會偵測到此預設集，請自行列出。
